capabilities: Commit pending Hangul composition when tapping, pressing Enter, using arrow keys, or running hotkeys
Commit composition before a command runs so hotkeys act on rendered text
Preserve the on-screen keyboard by briefly refocusing a hidden input instead of blurring
Provide a manual Commit Hangul composition command for the mobile toolbar or a hotkey
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README is duplicated in Korean and lists the tested environments: Android with Samsung Keyboard and Windows with the Microsoft Korean IME.
problem: When typing Korean, the last syllable stays in composing state, so Obsidian treats the line as still being edited and Live Preview fails to render checkboxes, lists, and callouts until you resort to workarounds like typing a dummy character.
summary: Input fix that commits unfinished Korean (Hangul) IME composition on taps, Enter, arrow keys, or hotkeys so Live Preview renders Markdown immediately.
